desktop.notesZh: 批次二十二（会话输入框「美化 / 回退」控件——本地确定性 Markdown 整理器，web 端真机探针 28 项断言全 PASS）：① 需求——会话框新增一个按钮，点击后把当前输入的文字做「优化与格式化」，用 Markdown 结构让用户把问题讲清楚、有条理；硬约束是不改写作者的用意、不私自增加内容；整理后的文字取代原文，按钮随即变为「回退」。② 落点——复用上游预留的 `conversation.input.right` 插槽（scope: session，standard props 含 `useInput` / `inputActions`），**不改上游 ui-conversation**；读草稿用 `useInput(s => s.draft)`，写回用 `inputActions.setDraft(text)`。③ 格式化是**本地确定性规则**（`draft-format.ts`），**不隐式调用大模型**：只加结构不加字——归一化换行与空行、保留既有围栏代码块 / 标题 / 列表 / 引用 / 表格、长段按句切分、引导词 + 顿号枚举转成要点列表、英文错误行与栈帧包进代码围栏；含 CJK 的行永不判为代码。零网络、零成本、零延迟，同一草稿结果恒定，完全可逆。④ 限制——草稿含 @ 文件引用时 `setDraft` 会丢 inline 引用 chip，此时按钮保持可见但阻塞并用 tooltip 说明原因；要支持需扩展上游 `InputActions` 增加文档级 setDraft，留作后续批次。⑤ 视觉——28×28 幽灵图标按钮，位于模型选择与发送按钮之前；字形用「文档 + 笔」`list-pen-outline`（不用 sparkle，避免暗示调用模型）；回退态穿金色发丝边 + 金色图标，金色为本地 token（亮色 #8a6d12 / 暗色 #d9b64c），暗色回退态对会话框卡片实测 7.13:1，暗色整块无白盒。⑥ 门禁——新增 35 个单测（格式化器 24 + 组件 11），两个新增源文件覆盖率 100%；vitest 35 passed / tsc 0 error / oxlint 新增文件 0 告警 / i18n 校验 33 条与基线一致 / build 10 passed 0 failed。
desktop.notesEn: Batch 22 (a "tidy up / revert" control in the conversation composer — a local deterministic Markdown arranger; the live web probe passed all 28 assertions): ① Requirement — a new button in the composer arranges the current draft into Markdown structure so the author can state the problem clearly and in order; hard constraints: never rewrite the author's intent, never add content on the side; the arranged text replaces the original and the button turns into "revert". ② Landing spot — the upstream-reserved `conversation.input.right` slot (scope: session; the standard props carry `useInput` / `inputActions`), with **no change to upstream ui-conversation**; the draft is read via `useInput(s => s.draft)` and written back via `inputActions.setDraft(text)`. ③ The arranger is a **local deterministic rule set** (`draft-format.ts`) and **does not implicitly call a model**: it adds structure only, never words — it normalizes line breaks and blank lines, keeps existing fenced code blocks / headings / lists / quotes / tables, splits long paragraphs by sentence, turns a lead word plus a Chinese enumeration into a bullet list, and wraps English error lines and stack frames in code fences; a line containing CJK is never taken for code. Zero network, zero cost, zero latency, the same draft always yields the same result, and the operation is fully reversible. ④ Limitation — when the draft holds @ file references, `setDraft` would drop the inline reference chips, so the control stays visible but blocked and the tooltip states the reason; supporting that case needs a document-level setDraft on the upstream `InputActions`, deferred to a later batch. ⑤ Visual — a 28×28 ghost icon button placed before the model selector and the send action; the glyph is the "document + pen" `list-pen-outline` (not a sparkle, which would imply a model call); the revert state wears a gold hairline border and a gold glyph, the gold being a local token (#8a6d12 light / #d9b64c dark); the dark-theme revert glyph measures 7.13:1 against the composer card, and the dark composer card has no white box at all. ⑥ Gates — 35 new unit tests (24 arranger + 11 component); both new source files reach 100% coverage; vitest 35 passed / tsc 0 errors / oxlint 0 findings on the new files / i18n verification still at the 33-item baseline / build 10 passed, 0 failed.
